summary: Matt Levine / Bloomberg: Anthropic's S-1 shows a governance structure that suits a fun quirky little mission-driven worker cooperative that needs to raise billions as a public company — Also share classes and fake polls. — Happy Anthropic S-1 day — Here's the draft prospectus for Anthropic PBC's initial public offering.
contentText:
Matt Levine / Bloomberg :

Anthropic's S-1 shows a governance structure that suits a fun quirky little mission-driven worker cooperative that needs to raise billions as a public company   —  Also share classes and fake polls.  —  Happy Anthropic S-1 day  —  Here's the draft prospectus for Anthropic PBC's initial public offering.
